newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ gov tells DKB, Nomura to prevent more scandals.
newsitem.headline: BOJ gov tells DKB, Nomura to prevent more scandals.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita on Wednesday told the presidents of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) and Nomura Securities Co Ltd to promptly take steps to prevent a recurrence of the scandal involving payoffs to a corporate racketeer.
The central bank released copies of letters from Matsushita to Nomura president Junichi Ujiie and DKB President Katsuyuki Sugita.
In the letters, Matsushita warned that the BOJ may take measures including reconsidering transaction relationships with the two institutions if their reform efforts prove to be insufficient.

The letters said the BOJ strongly hoped the managements of the two firms would be comprehensively reformed and would regain the confidence of both domestic and overseas clients as well as of market participants.
